map.体积与任一边长线性相关（其余固定）；三维同时放大 k 倍则体积放大 k³ 倍——: Volume is linear in any one edge (holding the others fixed); scaling all three dimensions by k multiplies the volume by k3, the square-cube law, while the surface area scales by k2.
